offers_products.reason: Innoviva Specialty Therapeutics sells XACDURO, ZEVTERA, giapreza and other critical care drugs; royalties derive from respiratory drugs.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from royalties and drug sales; no services are offered to customers as a main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Hospital-administered anti-infectives are chosen by institutions; royalty income comes from GSK, not individual buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Royalty payer GSK and hospitals and distributors buying critical care and anti-infective drugs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is ongoing royalties on Breo, Anoro and Trelegy sales, plus repeat hospital drug orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Respiratory medicines and critical care antibiotics are medical necessities, not easily postponed in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Royalty payments and drug purchases are small and frequent, not large infrequent sales.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is royalty streams and pharmaceutical products, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main revenue payer is GSK, a large pharma; other sales go to hospitals and wholesalers.

asset_heavy.reason: Royalty holder and drug commercializer with outsourced manufacturing; needs capital for acquisitions, not plants or fleets.
